definitions.explanation: Studying material before class or learning it in advance.

examples.japanese: {予習|よしゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}です→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧。
{予習|よしゅう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I attend class after preparing in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予習|よしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなければ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have to prepare for tomorrow's class.

notes:
{予習|よしゅう} means studying material before class so you are prepared for the lesson. It is a key concept in Japanese education.

LEARNING CYCLE:
- {予習|よしゅう}: preparation before class
- {授業|じゅぎょう}: class/lesson
- {復習|ふくしゅう}: review after class

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予習|よしゅう}する: to prepare (lessons)
- {予習|よしゅう}をする: to do preparation (slightly more formal)
- 〜の{予習|よしゅう}をする: to prepare for ~

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, teachers often expect students to do {予習|よしゅう} before class. The phrase {予習|よしゅう}{復習|ふくしゅう} (preparation and review) is a common pair, emphasizing the importance of studying both before and after class.

OPPOSITE:
{復習|ふくしゅう} — review (studying material again after class)
